title: design-map
description: In-repo manifest linking code components to design references for sources without a machine link (Stitch, Claude Design) or as an override for Figma.

tokens.description: Design-name to code-name token aliases, keyed by code token name. Lets token-compliance match tokens whose design and code vocabularies differ (e.g. code 'onSurface' <-> design 'color/on-surface').

aliasGroup.description: Code token name -> design token name.

refVariant.description: A reference handle tagged with the variant slot (state/theme/size) it fills.

ref.description: Source-specific reference handle(s). A string binds a single node. A list of variant-tagged handles binds several nodes (a screen's states/themes/sizes in separate frames). Figma: 'figma:<fileKey>/<nodeId>'. Stitch: 'stitch:<designId>'. Claude Design: repo-relative path to a committed HTML export. Bundle: repo-relative path to a committed directory or '.zip' of reference PNGs plus a manifest.json.

previewId.description: Optional compose-ai-tools preview id (e.g. 'ee.app.FooKt.Bar') this code handle renders as. Links a preview-bundle/daemon candidate (keyed by preview id) to this reference (keyed by code handle). See design-parity issue #44.
